chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Hajjal, from Ahmad ibn Umar al-Halabi, from Abu Basir who said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and said to him: May I be sacrificed for you! I want to ask you a question — is there anyone here who would hear my words? He said: So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) raised a curtain between him and another room, looked into it, then said: O Abu Muhammad! Ask about whatever comes to you.

He said: I said: May I be sacrificed for you! Your Shia followers narrate that the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) taught Ali (peace be upon him) a door (of knowledge) from which a thousand doors open for him. So he said: O Abu Muhammad! The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) taught Ali (peace be upon him) a thousand doors — from each door a thousand doors open. I said: This, by God, is the knowledge! He then made marks in the ground for a while, then said: It is a knowledge, but it is not that.

He then said: O Abu Muhammad! And with us is the Jami'a — and what do they know what the Jami'a is? I said: May I be sacrificed for you! And what is the Jami'a? He said: A parchment seventy cubits long by the cubit of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), dictated from his own mouth and written by Ali's right hand. In it is every permissible and forbidden thing, and everything the people need, to the extent of the blood-money for a scratch. He then extended his hand toward me and said: Do you permit me, O Abu Muhammad? I said: May I be sacrificed for you! I am but yours — do whatever you wish. So he pressed me with his hand and said: To the extent of this — as if he were angry. I said: This, by God, is the knowledge! He said: It is a knowledge, but it is not that.

Then he was silent for a while, then said: And with us is the Jafr — and what do they know what the Jafr is? I said: And what is the Jafr? He said: A leather vessel containing the knowledge of the prophets, the successors, and the scholars who have passed from the Children of Israel. I said: This is the knowledge! He said: It is a knowledge, but it is not that.

Then he was silent for a while, then said: And with us is the Parchment of Fatima (peace be upon her) — and what do they know what the Parchment of Fatima is? I said: And what is the Parchment of Fatima (peace be upon her)? He said: A parchment with three times the size of your Quran. By God! There is not a single letter from your Quran in it. I said: This, by God, is the knowledge! He said: It is a knowledge, but it is not that.

Then he was silent for a while, then said: With us is the knowledge of what has been and the knowledge of what will be until the Hour is established. I said: May I be sacrificed for you! This, by God, is the knowledge! He said: It is a knowledge, but it is not that.
He said: I said: May I be sacrificed for you! So what is the knowledge? He said: What newly occurs by night and by day — matter after matter and thing after thing — until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الأرش في الخدش: Blood-money for a scratch — indicating the Jami'a contains even the most minute legal rulings
key_terms.الجامعة: Al-Jami'a: A comprehensive parchment dictated by the Prophet and written by Imam Ali, containing all legal rulings
key_terms.الجفر: Al-Jafr: A leather vessel containing knowledge of the prophets, their successors, and the scholars of Bani Isra'il
key_terms.ما يحدث بالليل والنهار: What newly occurs by night and day — the continuously unfolding divine knowledge given to the Imams
key_terms.مصحف فاطمة: Mushaf Fatima: The Parchment of Lady Fatima, three times the size of the Quran but containing no Quranic text

ai.seo_question: What are the special books and repositories of knowledge possessed by the Shia Imams according to al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Abu Basir, a close companion of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), privately questions the Imam about the special repositories of knowledge possessed by the Imams. The Imam systematically describes four great sources — the thousand-door knowledge taught by the Prophet to Ali, the Jami'a (a comprehensive parchment of all legal rulings), the Jafr (a leather vessel with knowledge of prophets and successors), and the Mushaf Fatima (a parchment three times the size of the Quran) — yet declares each insufficient. In a climactic revelation, the Imam defines true Imamate knowledge as the divinely unfolding knowledge of events as they occur continuously through time, until the Day of Judgment.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Al Hajjal, from Ahmad Bin Umar Al Halby, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! I want to ask you<sup>asws</sup> a question. Is there anyone over here who would hear my speech?’ So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> raised a curtain between him<sup>asws</sup> and another room, and looked into it, then said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! Ask about whatever comes to you’.

He (Abu Baseer) said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Your<sup>asws</sup> Shias are narrating that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Ali<sup>asws</sup> such a door (of knowledge) that a thousand (other) doors (of knowledge) opened from it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Ali<sup>asws</sup> a thousand doors (of knowledge), there opening from each of the doors, a thousand (other) doors (of knowledge)’. I said, ‘This, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, is the knowledge!’. So he<sup>asws</sup> made marks in the ground for a while, then said: ‘It is a knowledge, but it is not that (knowledge)’.

He (Abu Baseer) said, ‘Then heasws said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! And with usasws is the Jami’e, and what do they (people) know what the Jami’e is?’ I said, ‘May be sacrificed for youasws! And what is the Jami’e? Heasws said: ‘A Parchment of the length of seventy cubits by the cubit (measurement) of Rasool-Allahsaww and hissaww dictation from hissaww own mouth, and handwritten by Aliasws by hisasws right hand. Therein are the Permissible and the Prohibitions, and everything that the people would be needy to, to the extent of the compensation regarding the scratch’, and heasws struck with hisasws hand towards me, and heasws said: ‘Will you permit measws, O Abu Muhammad? I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! But rather, I am for youasws, therefore do whatever you so desire to’. So heasws pressed me by hisasws hand and said: ‘To the extent of this’, as if heasws was angry. I said, ‘This, by Allahazwj, is the knowledge!’. Heasws said: ‘It is a knowledge, but it is not that (knowledge)!’

Then heasws was silent for a while, then said: ‘And with usasws is the Jaf’r, and what do they (people) know what the Jaf’r is?’ I said, ‘And what is the Jaf’r?’ Heasws said: ‘A receptacle from Adamas wherein is knowledge of the Prophetsas, and the successorsas, and knowledge of the scholars of the past from the Children of Israel’. I said, ‘This, is the knowledge!’ Heasws said: ‘It is knowledge, and it isn’t that (knowledge)!’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> was silent for a while, then said: ‘And with us<sup>asws</sup> is the Parchment of Syeda Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, and what do they (people) know what the Parchment of Fatima<sup>asws</sup> is?’ I said, ‘And what is the Parchment of Fatima<sup>asws</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A Parchment where is the likes of this Quran of yours three times over. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! And there is not a single letter from your Quran therein’. I said, ‘This, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, is the knowledge!’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a knowledge, but it is not that (knowledge)!’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> was silent for a while, then said: ‘With us<sup>asws</sup> is knowledge of whatever has happened, and what would be happening up to the establishment of the Hour’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! This, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, it is the knowledge!’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a knowledge, and it isn’t that (knowledge)!’.

He (Abu Baseer) said, ‘I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! So which thing is the knowledge?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whatever newly occurs by the night and the day, the matter after the matter, and the thing after the thing, up to the Day of Judgment’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Abdallah ibn al-Hajjal from Ahmad ibn ‘Umar al-Halabi from abu Basir who has said the following.

“I went to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) and said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, I like to ask you a question. Is there anyone else in this house who may hear my words?” The Imams (a.s.) then folded the curtain between his room and the other room next to it and looked into it. Then the Imams (a.s.) said, “O abu Muhammad, ask whatever you wish.”

I said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, your followers say that the Messenger of Allah taught Ali (a.s.) a thousand chapter of knowledge and from each chapter there opens a thousand chapter. I then said, ‘This, I swear by Allah, is knowledge.’” He would mark the ground with his staff (a sign of thinking in normal people) for a while and said, “That is knowledge but it is not that.”

The narrators has said that The Imam (a.s.) then said, “O abu Muhammad, with us there is al-Jami‘a. What do they know what al-Jami‘ is?” I then asked, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, what is al-Jami‘a? The Imam (a.s.) said, it is a parchment seventy yards by the yards of the Messenger of Allah long that contains his dictations that is in graved in to with the right hand writing of Ali (a.s.). It contains all the lawful and unlawful and all matters that people need, even the law to of compensation for A number of our people has narrated from scratch caused to a person. He then stretched his hand to me and asked, ‘May I, O abu Muhammad?’ I then replied, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, I am all at your disposal.” He pinched me with his hand and said, “Even there is the law of compensation for this.” He seemed angry. The narrator has said, “I then said, “This, I swear by Allah is knowledge.” The Imams (a.s.) said, “It certainly is knowledge but not that one.”

The Imams (a.s.) remained silent for a while and then said, “With us there is al-Jafr (the parchment). What do they know what al-Jafr is? I then asked, “What is al-Jafr (the parchment or a container) ?” The Imams (a.s.) said, “It is a container made of skin that contains the knowledge of the prophets and the executors of their wills and the knowledge of the scholars in the past from the Israelites.” The narrator has said that he then said, “This certainly, is the knowledge.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “It certainly is knowledge but not that knowledge.”

The Imams (a.s.) remained silent for a while and then said, “With us there is the book (Mushaf) of Fatima, (a.s.). What do they know what Mushaf of Fatima is? The Imam (a.s.) said, “Mushaf of Fatima is three times bigger than your Quran. There is not even a single letter therein from your Quran.” The narrator has said, “I then said, “This, I swear by Allah, is the knowledge.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “This certainly is knowledge, but it is not that.”

The Imam (a.s.) remained silent for a while and then said, “With us there is the knowledge of whatever has been and the knowledge of whatever will come into being to the Day of Judgment.” The narrator has said that he then said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, this, I swear by Allah is, certainly, knowledge.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “It certainly is knowledge but not that.”

The narrator has said that he then asked, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, What then is knowledge?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Whatever takes place during the night and during the day, one matter after the other matter and one thing after the other thing to the Day of Judgment.”
